observations.says: when the gate lamp was lit, the christening cup was at the vestry
against: before the gate lamp was lit

observations.says: after evensong on Sunday, the gate lamp was not yet lit
when the gate lamp was lit, the christening cup was at the vestry
from when the ferry cast off on Sunday until eight o'clock on Sunday, Silas Bell was at the ferry
from eight o'clock on Sunday until Monday morning, the ferry was moored at the far bank
when the gate lamp was lit, Amos Dunn locked the vestry door; at nine o'clock on Sunday, the vestry door was locked, with its lock not forced
nobody but Josiah Crane and Amos Dunn had a key of the vestry door
the ferry was the only boat on the water
after evensong on Sunday, Silas Bell was at the lych-gate
